caption: The drawing shows a single rectangular wooden door painted in a weathered greenish-blue color. The surface of the door is divided into panels of various shapes and sizes, each outlined by a beveled molding, forming a symmetrical but varied geometric pattern. Some of the panels are vertically oriented rectangles, while others are horizontal or square; most have decorative inset shapes with curved edges inside them. The paint appears chipped and worn in several areas, exposing patches of brown wood beneath, particularly along the left side near the middle and along the bottom edge. The door is positioned vertically on a plain, off-white background, and there are no additional objects or details surrounding or attached to the door in the drawing. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the words "Angelino Door" are written in small, neat handwriting.
title: Panel Door
